# WPMN Design System — Complete Reference

> Single source of truth for tokens, components, layout, logos, icons, and section patterns.
> Use this file as AI context for building WPMN product landing pages in HTML/CSS.
> No Figma workflow content — this is the HTML/CSS implementation reference.

**Version:** v2.0.0
**Stack:** React + plain CSS custom properties. No build step required.
**Font:** Work Sans only. Never substitute.
**Brands:** 16 products, all driven by a single token system.
**GitHub:** https://github.com/mehdi214designer/wpmn-design-tokens (branch: master)

## 1. What This File Covers

This is the complete design system reference for building WPMN product marketing pages in HTML/CSS. It covers every rule, token, component, pattern, and constraint needed to produce correct, on-brand output.

**When to use this file:**
- Building or generating any landing page section for a WPMN product
- Writing component CSS or JSX
- Checking token usage, spacing values, or color pairings
- Verifying section patterns, grid layouts, or section alternation rules

**Stack:**
- HTML + plain CSS custom properties
- React JSX (no build step — components run in a browser-native loader)
- Work Sans font via Google Fonts
- Inline SVG for all icons — no runtime icon library imports
- `data-brand="<key>"` on root element activates brand theming

**File structure:**
```
index.css               — imports all 4 token files in order
primitives.css          — raw base values (colors, spacing, radius)
brand-primitives.css    — per-brand color overrides via [data-brand="x"]
tokens.css              — semantic tokens mapped from primitives
typography.css          — type scale and utility classes
components/             — React + CSS components
logos/                  — SVG logo assets per brand (10 files per brand)
```

**Token cascade:**
```
[data-brand="fluentforms"] applied to root element
    └── overrides --primitive-primary-* and --primitive-accent-*
            └── tokens.css reads those primitives
                    └── --btn-bg-enable = var(--primitive-primary-500)
                    └── --color-text-brand = var(--primitive-accent-300)
                    └── all components update automatically
```

**Core rules (never break these):**
- Never use primitives directly in components — always use semantic tokens
- Never hardcode hex values — always use CSS custom properties
- Never use a font other than Work Sans
- Always set `data-brand` on the root element
- Never use `const` inside JSX function bodies — use `var`
- Always use inline SVG path data for icons — no runtime imports

## 2. Logos and Icons

### Logo File Structure

Each brand has exactly 10 logo files in `logos/<brand>/`:

| File | Description | When to use |
|---|---|---|
| `logo-primary.svg` | Full wordmark, full color | Brand-specific contexts |
| `logo-dark.svg` | Full wordmark, colored icon + dark text | Light / white backgrounds |
| `logo-inverted.svg` | Full wordmark, white icon + white text | Dark backgrounds |
| `logo-black.svg` | Full wordmark, all black | Special cases |
| `logo-white.svg` | Full wordmark, all white | Special cases |
| `icon-primary.svg` | Icon only, full color | Favicons, small spaces |
| `icon-dark.svg` | Icon only, dark | Small spaces on light bg |
| `icon-inverted.svg` | Icon only, white | Small spaces on dark bg |
| `icon-black.svg` | Icon only, black | Special cases |
| `icon-white.svg` | Icon only, white | Special cases |

**Logo selection by surface:**

| Surface | Use |
|---|---|
| `primary` (white) | `logo-dark.svg` |
| `alt` (soft gray) | `logo-dark.svg` |
| `secondary` (dark) | `logo-inverted.svg` |
| `secondary-alt` (soft dark) | `logo-inverted.svg` |
| Light navbar | `logo-dark.svg` |
| Dark navbar | `logo-inverted.svg` |
| Footer (always dark) | `logo-inverted.svg` |

**Rule: light background = dark logo. Dark background = inverted logo. Never the reverse.**

### HugeIcons — Inline SVG Components

**Library source:** `@hugeicons/react-pro` v0.3.2
**Variant used:** `stroke.rounded` — always, no exceptions
**File:** `components/Icons/HugeIcons.jsx`

All icons must be used as inline SVG in JSX. Never import from the library at runtime.

**Inline SVG pattern:**
```jsx
var _IconName = function(props) {
  return (
    <svg width={props.s} height={props.s} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
      <path d="..." stroke={props.c} strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
};
// Usage: <_IconName s={24} c="currentColor" />
```

**Icon sizes:**

| Size | Use |
|---|---|
| 20×20px | Buttons, inputs |
| 24×24px | Default, nav, inline |
| 32×32px | Feature cards |
| 40×40px | Large feature icons, hero |

**Color:** Always `currentColor` — inherits from parent text token.
**Exception:** Icon backgrounds with explicit brand color use `var(--btn-bg-enable)`.

## 4. Full Typography

**Font:** Work Sans (`'Work Sans', sans-serif`)
**Weights:** Regular 400 · Medium 500 · SemiBold 600 · Bold 700
**Import:** `<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Work+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">`

### Desktop Type Scale

| Class | Size | Line height | Weight | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `.text-h1` | 61px | 73px | Bold 700 | Hero headlines |
| `.text-h2` | 49px | 59px | Bold 700 | Section headlines |
| `.text-h3` | 39px | 47px | SemiBold 600 | Sub-section headlines |
| `.text-h4` | 31px | 37px | SemiBold 600 | Card titles |
| `.text-h5` | 25px | 30px | Medium 500 | Feature titles |
| `.text-h6` | 20px | 24px | Medium 500 | Small labels, captions |
| `.text-body-large` | 20px | 30px | Regular 400 | Hero subtext, intro paragraphs |
| `.text-body-medium` | 18px | 27px | Regular 400 | Standard body copy |
| `.text-body-base` | 16px | 24px | Regular 400 | Default paragraph text |
| `.text-body-small` | 14px | 21px | Regular 400 | Supporting text, hints |
| `.text-body-label` | 13px | 20px | Medium 500 | Labels, badges, captions |
| `.text-body-mono` | 10px | 15px | Regular 400 | Code, token display |

### Button Type Scale

| Class | Size | Line height | Weight |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.text-btn-xl` | 23px | 28px | SemiBold 600 |
| `.text-btn-lg` | 20px | 24px | SemiBold 600 |
| `.text-btn-md` | 18px | 20px | SemiBold 600 |
| `.text-btn-sm` | 16px | 18px | Medium 500 |
| `.text-btn-xs` | 13px | 16px | Medium 500 |

### Mobile Overrides (`max-width: 768px`)

| Class | Desktop | Mobile |
|---|---|---|
| `.text-h1` | 61px | 32px |
| `.text-h2` | 49px | 28px |
| `.text-h3` | 39px | 25px |
| `.text-h4` | 31px | 22px |
| `.text-h5` | 25px | 20px |
| `.text-h6` | 20px | 18px |
| `.text-body-large` | 20px | 18px |
| `.text-body-base` | 16px | 14px |
| `.text-body-small` | 14px | 12px |

### Typography Rules

- Always use `.text-*` utility classes — never hardcode font sizes
- Section headings and subtext: `max-width: 800px`, `text-align: center`
- Never use a font other than Work Sans
- Body text max-width: 560px when centered under a heading

**Highlighted / accented text in headings:**

Use `var(--btn-bg-enable)` directly — this is the one intentional place a semantic button token appears in text:

```html
<!-- DO -->
The Best <span style="color: var(--btn-bg-enable)">Form Builder</span>

<!-- DON'T -->
The Best <span style="color: #6b7280">Form Builder</span>
The Best <span style="color: var(--primitive-primary-500)">Form Builder</span>
```

### Typography CSS (exact)

```css
.text-h1 { font-size: 61px; line-height: 73px; font-weight: 700; }
.text-h2 { font-size: 49px; line-height: 59px; font-weight: 700; }
.text-h3 { font-size: 39px; line-height: 47px; font-weight: 600; }
.text-h4 { font-size: 31px; line-height: 37px; font-weight: 600; }

## 5. Full Token System

### How to Use Tokens

```css
/* Wrong — never do these */
color: #07090c;
color: var(--primitive-dark-800);
background: #2B6CFF;

/* Correct */
color: var(--color-text-primary);
background: var(--btn-bg-enable);
```

```html
<!-- Always set both attributes on root -->
<html data-theme="light" data-brand="fluentforms">
```

### Text Tokens

| Token | Light mode | Dark mode | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--color-text-primary` | #07090c | #ffffff | Headings on light surfaces |
| `--color-text-primary-invert` | #ffffff | #07090c | Headings on dark surfaces |
| `--color-text-secondary` | #4e5d78 | #dbdee4 | Body text on light surfaces |
| `--color-text-secondary-invert` | #dbdee4 | dark-500 | Body text on dark surfaces |
| `--color-text-brand` | `--primitive-accent-300` | `--primitive-accent-200` | Brand-colored inline text |

### Surface Tokens

| Token | Light mode | Dark mode | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--color-surface-primary` | #ffffff | #07090c | Default white section background |
| `--color-surface-alt` | #f6f7f8 | — | Soft gray section background |
| `--color-surface-secondary` | #07090c | #ffffff | Dark section background |
| `--color-surface-secondary-alt` | #171b24 | — | Soft dark section background |
| `--color-brand-surface` | `--primitive-accent-400` | `--primitive-primary-200` | Brand tint containers |
| `--color-brand-surface-secondary` | `--primitive-primary-200` | `--primitive-accent-100` | Secondary brand tint |

> Note: `--color-surface-alt` and `--color-surface-secondary-alt` may be missing from tokens.css in older builds. If missing, add manually:
> ```css
> --color-surface-alt: var(--primitive-light-25);          /* #f6f7f8 */
> --color-surface-secondary-alt: var(--primitive-dark-600); /* #171b24 */
> ```

### Border Tokens

| Token | Light mode | Dark mode |
|---|---|---|
| `--color-border-primary` | #dbdee4 | #0f1218 |
| `--color-border-primary-invert` | #0f1218 | #dbdee4 |

### Button Tokens

| Token | Description |
|---|---|
| `--btn-bg-enable` | Primary button background — always brand `primary-500` |
| `--btn-bg-hovered` | Hovered state — brand `primary-700` |
| `--btn-bg-pressed` | Pressed state |
| `--btn-bg-focused` | Focused state |
| `--btn-bg-disabled` | Disabled state |

### Status Tokens

| Token | Use |
|---|---|
| `--color-success-primary` | Success states |
| `--color-error-primary` | Error states |
| `--color-warning-primary` | Warning states |

### Shadow Tokens

**Hard shadows** — crisp, use for cards, menus, interactive elements:

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| `--shadow-hard-100` | `0px 1px 3px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.20)` |
| `--shadow-hard-300` | `0px 3px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.17)` |
| `--shadow-hard-500` | `0px 6px 10px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.10)` |
| `--shadow-hard-700` | `0px 9px 12px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.10)` |
| `--shadow-hard-1000` | `0px 24px 38px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.10)` |

**Soft shadows** — diffused, use for mockups, modals, elevated surfaces:

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| `--shadow-soft-100` | `0px 12px 12px -15px rgba(0,0,16,0.10)` |
| `--shadow-soft-300` | `0px 24px 24px -24px rgba(0,0,16,0.15)` |
| `--shadow-soft-400` | `0px 24px 48px -20px rgba(0,0,16,0.10)` |
| `--shadow-soft-600` | `0px 72px 72px -40px rgba(0,0,16,0.10)` |
| `--shadow-soft-800` | `0px 72px 96px -18px rgba(0,0,16,0.10)` |

**Shadow usage for mockups:**

| Token | Use |
|---|---|
| `--shadow-soft-400` | Minimum — small mockups, light sections |
| `--shadow-soft-600` | Standard — most mockups |
| `--shadow-soft-800` | Hero mockups, large showcase blocks |

### Token Cascade Explanation

```
index.css
  ├── primitives.css        → defines --primitive-light-*, --primitive-dark-*,
  │                           --primitive-space-*, --primitive-radius-*
  ├── brand-primitives.css  → [data-brand="x"] overrides --primitive-primary-*
  │                           and --primitive-accent-* for that brand
  ├── tokens.css            → semantic tokens read the primitives:
  │                           --btn-bg-enable: var(--primitive-primary-500)
  │                           --color-text-brand: var(--primitive-accent-300)
  └── typography.css        → .text-* utility classes
```

When you change `data-brand`, the brand-primitives override fires, which propagates through all semantic tokens automatically. Components never reference primitives directly — they always consume semantic tokens. This is what makes brand switching work with a single attribute change.

### Button

**Files:** `components/Button/Button.jsx` + `Button.css`

#### Props

| Prop | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `primary` · `secondary` · `tertiary` | `primary` |
| `size` | `xl` · `lg` · `md` · `sm` · `xs` | `md` |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` |
| `loading` | boolean — shows spinner | `false` |
| `fullWidth` | boolean | `false` |
| `iconLeft` | ReactNode | `null` |
| `iconRight` | ReactNode | `null` |

#### Size Specs

| Size | Height | Padding X | Gap | Radius | Font class |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| xl | 64px | 32px | 8px | 8px | `.text-btn-xl` (23px SemiBold) |
| lg | 56px | 32px | 8px | 8px | `.text-btn-lg` (20px SemiBold) |
| md | 48px | 24px | 8px | 8px | `.text-btn-md` (18px SemiBold) |
| sm | 40px | 20px | 4px | 8px | `.text-btn-sm` (16px Medium) |
| xs | 32px | 16px | 4px | 4px | `.text-btn-xs` (13px Medium) |

#### When to Use Each Size

| Context | Size |
|---|---|
| Hero section CTAs | `lg` (56px) |
| Section CTAs (features, pricing, testimonials) | `md` (48px) |
| Dark CTA banner | `lg` (56px) |
| Inside cards or feature tiles | `sm` (40px) |
| NavBar CTA | `sm` (40px) |
| Inline / text-level CTAs | `xs` (32px) |
| Full-page promotional hero (extra prominence) | `xl` (64px) |

#### Button CSS (exact)

```css
/* Base */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  border: none;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Sizes */
.btn-xl { height: 64px; padding: 0 32px; font-size: 23px; }
.btn-lg { height: 56px; padding: 0 32px; font-size: 20px; }
.btn-md { height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; font-size: 18px; }
.btn-sm { height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; }
.btn-xs { height: 32px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 4px; }

/* Primary */
.btn-primary {
  background: var(--btn-bg-enable);
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: inset 3px 4px 4px 0px rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
}
.btn-primary:hover {
  background: var(--btn-bg-hovered);
  box-shadow: inset 3px 4px 4px 0px rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
}

/* Secondary */
.btn-secondary {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--btn-bg-enable);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--btn-bg-enable);
}
.btn-secondary:hover {
  background: var(--btn-bg-enable);
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: inset 3px 4px 4px 0px rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
}

/* Ghost inverted (secondary on dark backgrounds) */
.btn-ghost-invert {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-text-primary-invert);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
}
.btn-ghost-invert:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
}

/* White button (for gradient/colored card CTAs) */
.btn-white {
  background: #ffffff;
  color: var(--btn-bg-enable);
  box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}
.btn-white:hover {
  background: var(--primitive-primary-50);
}
```

#### Usage

```jsx
<Button type="primary" size="lg">Free Download</Button>
<Button type="secondary" size="lg">Buy Now</Button>
```

**Rules:**
- Always pair primary + secondary side by side — never just one, never stacked
- Never hardcode button background — always uses `--btn-bg-enable`
- Default size for hero and dark CTAs: `lg`. For section CTAs: `md`. Never default to `md` without thinking.

### NavBar

**Files:** `components/NavBar/NavBar.jsx` + `NavBar.css`

Logo + nav links + CTA button. Responsive: full nav on desktop, hamburger drawer on mobile.

#### Props

| Prop | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `brand` | brand key (e.g. `"fluentforms"`) | — |
| `theme` | `"light"` · `"dark"` | `"light"` |
| `links` | array of `{ label, href }` | — |
| `cta` | `{ label, href }` | — |

**Logo rules:**
- Light navbar → `type="dark"` logo (`logo-dark.svg`)
- Dark navbar → `type="inverted"` logo (`logo-inverted.svg`)

// Light navbar or white/gray surface
<Logo brand="fluentforms" type="dark" height={32} />

<div class="badge">

```css
.badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: var(--primitive-primary-50);
  color: var(--primitive-primary-600);
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.badge-dot {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--btn-bg-enable);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Dark surface variant */
.badge-dark {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
}
.badge-dark .badge-dot {
  background: var(--primitive-accent-400);
}
```

## 7. Full Guidelines

### Layout and Grids

**Container:**

```css
.container {
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 24px;
}
```

**Section padding:**

```css
.section { padding: 96px 0; }
@media (max-width: 768px) { .section { padding: 64px 0; } }
```

**Seven approved grid layouts — never use anything outside these:**

| # | Name | Columns | Gutter | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Full width | 12/12 | — | Hero, CTA banners, testimonials |
| 2 | Equal 2-col | 6/6 | 48px | Text + mockup, hero split |
| 3 | Equal 3-col | 4/4/4 | 32px | Feature cards, pricing |
| 4 | Equal 4-col | 3/3/3/3 | 24px | Icon rows, stat cards |
| 5 | Asymmetric | 5/7 | 48px | Text-heavy left + large visual right |
| 6 | Asymmetric | 4/8 | 48px | Sidebar label + main content |
| 7 | Stacked | 6 + (6/6) | 48px outer / 24px inner | Large card left, two stacked right |

```css
.grid-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 48px; }
.grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 32px; }
.grid-4 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
.grid-5-7 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5fr 7fr; gap: 48px; }
.grid-4-8 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4fr 8fr; gap: 48px; }
```

**Responsive breakpoints:**

| Breakpoint | Width | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| Desktop | ≥ 1200px | Full layout, centered container |
| Tablet | 768px–1199px | Container fills width, 40px side padding, 2-col stays 2-col |
| Mobile | < 768px | All columns stack to 1-col, 20px side padding, 64px section padding |

---

### Section Header Anatomy

Every section follows this exact order (top to bottom):

```
[Badge]     — optional. Pill variant. Uppercase. Dot prefix. Brand accent color.
Heading     — required. Max 800px wide. Center-aligned.
[Subtext]   — optional. 1–2 sentences max. Center-aligned. Max 560px wide.
[CTA]       — optional. Always primary + secondary paired. Never solo.
```

```html
<div class="section-header">
  <div class="badge"><span class="badge-dot"></span>SECTION LABEL</div>
  <h2 class="text-h2" style="max-width:800px;margin:0 auto 16px;text-align:center">Section Heading</h2>
  <p class="text-body-large" style="max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;color:var(--color-text-secondary);text-align:center">Optional subtext goes here.</p>
</div>
```

---

### Section Backgrounds and Alternation

**Four surface types:**

| Name | Token | Primitive | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| primary | `--color-surface-primary` | `--primitive-light-0` | White — default, starting point |
| alt | `--color-surface-alt` | `--primitive-light-25` | Soft gray — separates without hard contrast |
| secondary | `--color-surface-secondary` | `--primitive-dark-800` | Dark — max 1–2 per page |
| secondary-alt | `--color-surface-secondary-alt` | `--primitive-dark-600` | Soft dark — variation within dark |

**Text token pairings per surface — never mix these up:**

| Surface | Heading token | Body token |
|---|---|---|
| primary | `--color-text-primary` | `--color-text-secondary` |
| alt | `--color-text-primary` | `--color-text-secondary` |
| secondary | `--color-text-primary-invert` | `--color-text-secondary-invert` |
| secondary-alt | `--color-text-primary-invert` | `--color-text-secondary-invert` |

**Recommended page section sequence:**

| Section | Surface | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| NavBar | — | Sits above page flow |
| Hero | primary | Always white. Clean entry point. |
| Features | alt | Soft gray separates from hero. |
| Showcase / Demo | primary | Back to white. |
| Dark CTA / Testimonials | secondary | One dark emphasis section. |
| Pricing | alt | Back to light immediately after dark. |
| FAQ / Final CTA | primary | — |
| Footer | secondary | Always dark. Does not count against dark budget. |

**Rules:**
- Maximum 1–2 dark sections per page (footer doesn't count)
- Never two dark sections back to back
- Never two identical surfaces back to back

```
DO:    primary → alt → primary → secondary → alt → primary
DON'T: secondary → secondary
DON'T: alt → alt
```

---

### Within-Section Spacing

| From → To | Gap |
|---|---|
| Badge → Heading | 12px |
| Heading → Subtext | 16px |
| Subtext → Content area | 48px |
| Section header → CTA buttons | 32px |
| CTA group → Mockup (hero only) | 64px |
| Between 3-col cards | 32px |
| Between 4-col cards | 24px |
| Icon → Card heading | 12px |
| Card heading → Card body | 8px |
| Two-col column gap | 48px |

---

### Mockup Treatment

**Rules:**
- Border radius: 16px on mockup frame
- Shadow: `--shadow-soft-400` minimum — never no shadow
- Hero mockups use `--shadow-soft-800`
- No border on the mockup frame — shadow provides the elevation
- Mockups float directly on the section background — no dark or colored wrapper

```css
.mockup-frame {
  border-radius: 16px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft-600);
  overflow: hidden;
  /* NO border */
  /* NO background wrapper */
}
```

**Hero mockup variant (top corners only, bleeds to bottom):**
```css
.mockup-frame--hero {
  border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft-800);
}
```

**Optional browser frame:**

| Element | Value |
|---|---|
| Title bar background | `var(--color-surface-alt)` |
| Traffic lights | #ff5f57 · #febc2e · #28c840 |
| Title bar border | `1px solid var(--color-border-primary)` |
| Content area | #ffffff |

**Never:**
- No shadow on a mockup
- Radius below 8px
- A dark or colored wrapper behind the mockup
- A border on the mockup frame
- Raster images without frame treatment
- Distorted or stretched screenshots

---

### Logo Usage Rules

- Always use SVG — never placeholders, rasters, or text substitutes
- Dark logo on light backgrounds, inverted logo on dark backgrounds — never the reverse
- Never scale logos below minimum readable size
- For inline use: embed the SVG path directly, no `<img>` tag

---

### Icon Rules

- Variant: `stroke.rounded` always
- Always inline SVG path data — never import from a library at runtime
- Default size: 24×24px
- Color: always `currentColor` — inherits from parent
- Exception: icon background containers use `var(--btn-bg-enable)` explicitly

```jsx
var _MyIcon = function(props) {
  return (
    <svg width={props.s} height={props.s} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
      <path d="..." stroke={props.c} strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
};
// <_MyIcon s={24} c="currentColor" />
```

---

### Code Rules

| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| No `const` inside JSX function bodies | Use `var` instead — the demo loader uses a last-`const` heuristic |
| No runtime icon imports | Always inline SVG path data |
| Semantic tokens only in components | Never use raw primitives or hex in component CSS |
| No hardcoded hex in components | Always `var(--token-name)` |
| CSS for components duplicated in demo.html | CSS `@import` gets stripped by the loader |

---

### All 14 + 5 Section Patterns

---

#### Pattern 01 — 3-col Image Cards

**When to use:** Blog/resource grids, use case showcases, content hubs.
**Surface:** `primary` (white) or `alt` (soft gray).

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-white">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-header"> <!-- badge, h2, subtext --> </div>
    <div class="grid-3">
      <div class="img-card">
        <div class="img-card-img"><!-- 200px tall image area --></div>
        <div class="img-card-body">
          <div class="img-card-tag">Tutorial</div>
          <div class="img-card-title">Card title</div>
          <div class="img-card-text">Card description.</div>
          <a href="#" class="img-card-link">Read article →</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <!-- × 3 -->
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key CSS:**
```css
.grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 32px; }
.img-card { background: var(--color-surface-primary); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; }
.img-card-img { height: 200px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.img-card-body { padding: 24px; }
.img-card-tag { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--primitive-primary-500); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.img-card-title { font-size: 20px; line-height: 26px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text-primary); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.img-card-text { font-size: 15px; line-height: 23px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); margin-bottom: 16px; }
.img-card-link { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--btn-bg-enable); text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
```

**Don'ts:** Don't add borders to cards. Don't exceed 32px gap. Don't use 4-col for image cards with body text.

---

#### Pattern 02 — 4-col Image Cards

**When to use:** Compact use case tiles, feature categories with images.
**Surface:** `alt` (soft gray) preferred.

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-alt">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-header"> <!-- badge, h2, subtext --> </div>
    <div class="grid-4">
      <div class="img-card img-card-sm">
        <div class="img-card-img" style="height:140px"><!-- image --></div>
        <div class="img-card-body">
          <div class="img-card-tag">Category</div>
          <div class="img-card-title">Card title</div>
          <div class="img-card-text">Short description.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <!-- × 4 -->
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key CSS:**
```css
.grid-4 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
.img-card-sm .img-card-img { height: 140px; }
.img-card-sm .img-card-body { padding: 20px; }
.img-card-sm .img-card-title { font-size: 17px; line-height: 23px; }
```

**Don'ts:** Don't use 4-col for content with long body text. Don't mix card sizes in the same grid.

---

#### Pattern 03 — Bento Grid

**When to use:** Feature highlights with mixed emphasis — one hero feature, several supporting ones.
**Surface:** `primary` (white) or `alt`.

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-white">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-header"> <!-- badge, h2 --> </div>
    <div class="bento">
      <div class="bento-card bento-large"><!-- 2-col wide --></div>
      <div class="bento-card bento-tall bento-accent"><!-- 1-col, 2-row tall, brand color --></div>
      <div class="bento-card bento-accent-sub"><!-- small, light brand tint --></div>
      <div class="bento-card" style="background:var(--color-surface-alt)"><!-- small, gray --></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key CSS:**
```css
.bento { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
.bento-card { background: var(--color-surface-primary); border-radius: 20px; padding: 32px; overflow: hidden; }
.bento-large { grid-column: span 2; }
.bento-tall { grid-row: span 2; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.bento-accent { background: var(--primitive-primary-500); }
.bento-accent h3, .bento-accent p { color: #fff; }
.bento-accent p { opacity: 0.8; }
.bento-accent-sub { background: var(--primitive-primary-50); }
```

**Don'ts:** Don't exceed 3 columns. Don't put long text in small bento cells. Don't use on dark section backgrounds.

---

#### Pattern 04 — Icon + Text (Horizontal List)

**When to use:** Detailed feature explanations where each feature warrants a paragraph.
**Surface:** `alt` (soft gray) preferred. Often paired with a 5/7 grid — text CTA left, icon list right.

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-alt">
  <div class="container">
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 7fr;gap:80px;align-items:flex-start">
      <div>
        <div class="badge">...</div>
        <h2 class="text-h2" style="margin-bottom:16px">Heading</h2>
        <p class="text-body-large" style="color:var(--color-text-secondary);margin-bottom:32px">Subtext</p>
        <div class="cta-group">
          <a class="btn btn-primary btn-md">Primary CTA</a>
          <a class="btn btn-secondary btn-md">Secondary CTA</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="icon-text-list">
        <div class="icon-text-row">
          <div class="it-icon"><!-- 24px inline SVG icon --></div>
          <div class="it-content">
            <h3>Feature title</h3>
            <p>Feature description paragraph.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <!-- × 3–5 rows -->
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key CSS:**
```css
.icon-text-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.icon-text-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px 1fr; gap: 24px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 32px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-primary); }
.icon-text-row:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border-primary); }
.it-icon { width: 52px; height: 52px; background: var(--primitive-primary-50); border-radius: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--btn-bg-enable); flex-shrink: 0; }
.it-content h3 { font-size: 20px; line-height: 26px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.it-content p { font-size: 16px; line-height: 25px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); }
```

**Don'ts:** Don't use more than 5 rows — gets too long. Don't center-align — this is always left-aligned.

---

#### Pattern 05 — Zigzag / Alternating 2-col

**When to use:** Feature deep-dives with alternating text+visual layout. Typically 2–4 rows.
**Surface:** `primary` (white).

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-white">
  <div class="container">
    <!-- Row 1: text left, image right -->
    <div class="zigzag-row">
      <div class="zz-text">
        <div class="badge">...</div>
        <h2>Heading</h2>
        <p>Description</p>
        <ul class="zz-check-list">
          <li><span class="zz-check">✓</span>Bullet point</li>
        </ul>
        <div class="cta-group cta-left">
          <a class="btn btn-primary btn-md">CTA</a>
          <a class="btn btn-secondary btn-md">Secondary</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="zz-img">
        <div class="zz-img-inner" style="background:...;height:300px">image</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <!-- Row 2: image left, text right (swap order) -->
    <div class="zigzag-row">
      <div class="zz-img">...</div>
      <div class="zz-text">...</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key CSS:**
```css
.zigzag-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 80px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 80px; }
.zigzag-row:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.zz-img { border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; }
.zz-img-inner { height: 300px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.zz-text h2 { font-size: 35px; line-height: 43px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.zz-text p { font-size: 17px; line-height: 27px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); margin-bottom: 28px; }
.zz-check-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 28px; }
.zz-check-list li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); }
.zz-check { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--primitive-primary-50); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
```

**Don'ts:** Don't exceed 4 zigzag rows — use a different pattern for longer lists. Don't center-align text in zigzag rows.

---

#### Pattern 06 — Sticky Text + Scrolling Cards

**When to use:** Step-by-step or how-it-works sections where context needs to stay visible while user scrolls cards.
**Surface:** `alt` (soft gray).

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-alt">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="sticky-wrap">
      <div class="sticky-left">
        <div class="badge">...</div>
        <h2>Heading</h2>
        <p>Subtext</p>
        <div class="cta-group cta-left">
          <a class="btn btn-primary btn-md">CTA</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="sticky-right">
        <div class="sticky-card">
          <div class="sticky-card-num">Step 01</div>
          <h3>Card heading</h3>
          <p>Card description</p>
          <div class="sticky-card-img"><!-- visual --></div>
        </div>
        <!-- × 3–4 cards -->
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key CSS:**
```css
.sticky-wrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 80px; align-items: flex-start; }
.sticky-left { position: sticky; top: 80px; }
.sticky-right { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; }
.sticky-card { background: var(--color-surface-primary); border-radius: 20px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-primary); transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; }
.sticky-card:hover { border-color: var(--primitive-primary-200); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft-400); }
.sticky-card-num { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primitive-primary-500); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.sticky-card-img { height: 160px; border-radius: 10px; margin-top: 20px; }
```

**Don'ts:** Don't use more than 4 cards. Don't put CTAs on individual sticky cards. Don't use on mobile without disabling sticky (set `position: static` on mobile).

---

#### Pattern 07 — Stacking Cards

**When to use:** Three-principle or three-promise sections. Creates a visually layered, scrolljacking effect.
**Surface:** `primary` (white).

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-white">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-header">...</div>
    <div class="sc-wrap">
      <div class="sc-card"> <!-- white, z-index 1, top: 80px -->
        <div class="sc-left">
          <span class="sc-num">01</span>
          <h3>Card heading</h3>
          <p>Card description</p>
        </div>
        <div class="sc-vis"><!-- emoji or image --></div>
      </div>
      <div class="sc-card"> <!-- light brand tint, z-index 2, top: 96px -->...</div>
      <div class="sc-card"> <!-- brand color, z-index 3, top: 112px -->...</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key CSS:**
```css
.sc-card {
  position: sticky;
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 56px 64px;
  width: 100%;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 64px;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 360px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.sc-card:nth-child(1) { top: 80px;  z-index: 1; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-primary); }
.sc-card:nth-child(2) { top: 96px;  z-index: 2; background: var(--primitive-primary-50); border: 1px solid var(--primitive-primary-100); }
.sc-card:nth-child(3) { top: 112px; z-index: 3; background: var(--primitive-primary-500); }
.sc-card:nth-child(3) h3, .sc-card:nth-child(3) p { color: #fff; }
.sc-card:nth-child(3) p { opacity: 0.75; }
.sc-num { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: var(--primitive-primary-100); margin-bottom: 16px; display: block; }
.sc-vis { height: 240px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--primitive-primary-50); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 72px; }
```

**Scale effect JS (optional enhancement):**
```js
(function() {
  var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.sc-card');
  function update() {
    cards.forEach(function(card, i) {
      var rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      var stickyTop = 80 + i * 16;
      var stuckBy = stickyTop - rect.top;
      if (stuckBy > 0 && i < cards.length - 1) {
        var progress = Math.min(1, stuckBy / 180);
        card.style.transform = 'scale(' + (1 - progress * 0.025) + ')';
        card.style.transformOrigin = 'top center';
      } else {
        card.style.transform = '';
      }
    });
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', update, { passive: true });
  update();
})();
```

**Don'ts:** Don't use more than 3 stacking cards. Don't use on sections with subtext longer than 2 sentences.

---

#### Pattern 08 — Process / Steps

**When to use:** Onboarding flow, how-it-works, numbered sequential steps.
**Surface:** `alt` (soft gray).

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-alt">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-header">...</div>
    <div class="steps-row">
      <div class="step-item">
        <div class="step-dot">1</div>
        <h3>Step title</h3>
        <p>Short description.</p>
      </div>
      <!-- × 4 steps -->
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key CSS:**
```css
.steps-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 0;
  position: relative;
}
.steps-row::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 28px;
  left: 60px;
  right: 60px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--primitive-primary-100);
  z-index: 0;
}
.step-item { text-align: center; padding: 0 16px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.step-dot {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--btn-bg-enable);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin: 0 auto 20px;
  box-shadow: inset 3px 4px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.3), 0 0 0 8px var(--primitive-primary-50);
}
.step-item h3 { font-size: 18px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.step-item p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 22px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); }
```

**Don'ts:** Don't use more than 4 steps. Don't add CTAs inside individual steps. Hide the connector line on mobile (`display: none`).

---

#### Pattern 09 — Large Quote Testimonial

**When to use:** Single powerful testimonial, social proof emphasis.
**Surface:** `primary` (white) or `secondary` (dark).

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-white">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="big-quote">
      <div class="big-quote-mark">"</div>
      <p class="big-quote-text">Full testimonial quote text goes here. Make it 2–4 sentences.</p>
      <div class="big-quote-author">
        <div class="big-quote-av">MK</div>
        <div>
          <div class="big-quote-name">Person Name</div>
          <div class="big-quote-role">Title, Company — context</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key CSS:**
```css
.big-quote { max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }
.big-quote-mark { font-size: 96px; line-height: .8; color: var(--primitive-primary-200); font-family: Georgia, serif; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.big-quote-text { font-size: 28px; line-height: 42px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-text-primary); margin-bottom: 32px; }
.big-quote-author { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; }
.big-quote-av { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--btn-bg-enable); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 3px 4px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
.big-quote-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text-primary); }
.big-quote-role { font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); }
```

**Don'ts:** Don't truncate the quote. Don't use without a real name and role. Don't stack multiple big quotes in the same section.

---

#### Pattern 10 — Comparison Table

**When to use:** Feature comparison against competitors. Usually anchored near pricing.
**Surface:** `alt` (soft gray) — table has white card inside.

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-alt">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-header">...</div>
    <div style="background:var(--color-surface-primary);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden">
      <table class="compare-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Feature</th>
            <th class="featured">This Product</th>
            <th>Competitor A</th>
            <th>Competitor B</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr>
            <td>Feature name</td>
            <td class="check col-featured">✓ Included</td>
            <td class="cross">✗ No</td>
            <td class="cross">Paid add-on</td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key CSS:**
```css
.compare-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.compare-table th { padding: 16px 24px; text-align: left; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--color-text-secondary); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-border-primary); }
.compare-table th.featured { color: var(--btn-bg-enable); }
.compare-table td { padding: 16px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-primary); font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-text-primary); }
.compare-table td.check { color: var(--btn-bg-enable); font-weight: 600; }
.compare-table td.cross { color: var(--color-text-secondary); }
.compare-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.compare-table tr:hover td { background: var(--primitive-primary-50); }
.col-featured { background: var(--primitive-primary-50); }
```

**Don'ts:** Don't add more than 4 columns. Don't use without a clear "featured" column highlighting your product.

#### Pattern 11 — Stats with Icon Cards

**When to use:** Social proof numbers, key metrics, trust-building stats.
**Surface:** `primary` (white) or `secondary` (dark).

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-white">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-header">...</div>
    <div class="stats-icon-grid">
      <div class="stat-icon-card">
        <div class="stat-icon-icon"><!-- 28px inline SVG --></div>
        <div class="stat-icon-num">400K+</div>
        <div class="stat-icon-lbl">Metric label</div>
      </div>
      <!-- × 4 -->
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key CSS:**
```css
.stats-icon-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
.stat-icon-card { background: var(--color-surface-primary); border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; text-align: center; }
.stat-icon-icon { width: 56px; height: 56px; background: var(--primitive-primary-50); border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin: 0 auto 16px; color: var(--btn-bg-enable); }
.stat-icon-num { font-size: 42px; line-height: 50px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-text-primary); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.stat-icon-lbl { font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); }
```

**Don'ts:** Don't use more than 4 stat cards per row. Don't put long labels — keep to 3–4 words max.

#### Pattern 12 — CTA with Gradient Background Card

**When to use:** Mid-page promotional call-to-action, limited-time offer, upsell.
**Surface:** `alt` — the CTA card itself has a gradient background and sits inside the alt section.

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-alt">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="cta-bg">
      <div class="cta-bg-text">
        <div class="badge badge-dark">...</div>
        <h2>Heading</h2>
        <p>Subtext</p>
        <div class="cta-group cta-left">
          <a class="btn btn-white btn-lg">Primary CTA</a>
          <a class="btn btn-ghost-invert btn-lg">Secondary CTA</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="cta-bg-visual"><!-- visual element --></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key CSS:**
```css
.cta-bg {
  border-radius: 24px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primitive-primary-600) 0%, var(--primitive-primary-900) 100%);
  padding: 80px 64px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 48px;
  align-items: center;
}
.cta-bg-text h2 { font-size: 42px; line-height: 51px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.cta-bg-text p { font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); margin-bottom: 32px; }
.cta-bg-visual { border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; height: 280px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
```

**Note:** Use `.btn-white` for primary button on this pattern, not `.btn-primary`. Primary CTA should have white background + brand text color on a dark gradient card.

**Don'ts:** Don't use `.btn-primary` directly on the gradient card — use `.btn-white`. Don't use on a section that is already dark — it doubles the dark sections.

---

#### Pattern 13 — Marquee Logo Strip

**When to use:** "Trusted by" social proof, partner logos, integration logos. Low-profile, space-efficient.
**Surface:** `primary` (white). Reduced padding (48px not 96px).

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-white" style="padding: 48px 0">
  <p style="text-align:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--color-text-secondary);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:28px">
    Trusted by teams at
  </p>
  <div class="marquee-wrap">
    <div class="marquee-track">
      <span class="marquee-item">Company A</span>
      <span class="marquee-item">Company B</span>
      <!-- ... repeat all items twice for seamless loop -->
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key CSS:**
```css
.marquee-wrap { overflow: hidden; }
.marquee-track {
  display: flex;
  gap: 64px;
  animation: marquee 20s linear infinite;
  width: max-content;
}
@keyframes marquee {
  from { transform: translateX(0); }
  to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}
.marquee-item {
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--primitive-primary-300);
  opacity: 0.5;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
```

**Don'ts:** Don't use full 96px section padding — this is a strip, not a full section. Don't add a section header — just the label and the marquee. Don't show this between two dark sections.

#### Pattern 14 — Dark CTA (Centered)

**When to use:** Final CTA before the footer. Page closer. Maximum impact.
**Surface:** `secondary` (dark). Text is always inverted.

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section section-dark" style="text-align:center">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="badge badge-dark"><span class="badge-dot"></span>GET STARTED TODAY</div>
    <h2 class="text-h2" style="max-width:800px;margin:0 auto 16px;color:var(--color-text-primary-invert)">
      Start building better forms today
    </h2>
    <p class="text-body-large" style="max-width:560px;margin:0 auto 32px;color:var(--color-text-secondary-invert)">
      Join 400,000+ WordPress sites that trust FluentForms.
    </p>
    <div class="cta-group cta-center">
      <a class="btn btn-primary btn-lg">Get for Free</a>
      <a class="btn btn-ghost-invert btn-lg">Talk to Sales</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Don'ts:** Don't use a white or light background for this pattern. Don't use `.btn-secondary` on dark sections — use `.btn-ghost-invert`. Don't put this pattern next to another dark section.

#### Pattern 15 — Hero with Mockup

**When to use:** Page hero section, always first after navbar.
**Surface:** `primary` (white), `padding-bottom: 0` — mockup bleeds to the bottom edge.

**HTML structure:**
```html
<section class="section-white" style="padding: 96px 0 0; text-align: center; overflow: hidden;">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="badge"><span class="badge-dot"></span>BADGE LABEL</div>
    <h1 class="text-h1" style="max-width:800px;margin:0 auto 16px">
      Hero headline with <span style="color:var(--btn-bg-enable)">accent word</span>
    </h1>
    <p class="text-body-large" style="max-width:560px;margin:0 auto 32px;color:var(--color-text-secondary)">
      Hero subtext — 1 sentence max.
    </p>
    <div class="cta-group cta-center" style="margin-bottom:64px">
      <a class="btn btn-primary btn-lg">Free Download</a>
      <a class="btn btn-secondary btn-lg">View Demo</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="container">
    <div class="mockup-frame" style="border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;box-shadow:var(--shadow-soft-800);overflow:hidden;max-width:960px;margin:0 auto">
      <div class="browser-bar" style="background:var(--color-surface-alt);border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border-primary);padding:12px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px">
        <span style="width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff5f57;display:inline-block"></span>
        <span style="width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#febc2e;display:inline-block"></span>
        <span style="width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#28c840;display:inline-block"></span>
      </div>
      <div class="mockup-content" style="background:#fff">
        <!-- product screenshot -->
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key rules:**
- `padding-bottom: 0` on the hero section — mockup bleeds to bottom edge
- `64px` margin-bottom on `.cta-group` — this is the only gap between CTA and mockup
- `border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0` — top corners only
- NO border on the mockup frame
- NO wrapper div around the mockup with a background color

#### Pattern 16 — Features Grid (3-col)

**When to use:** Feature overview sections, benefit grids, capability lists.
**Surface:** `alt` (soft gray).

**HTML structure:**

<section class="section section-alt">

      <div class="badge">...</div>
      <h2 class="text-h2" style="max-width:800px;margin:0 auto 16px">Heading</h2>

.feature-card { background: var(--color-surface-primary); border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; }

#### Pattern 17 — Dark CTA Banner (Standard)

**When to use:** Mid-page emphasis CTA, not the final closer. Simpler than Pattern 14.
**Surface:** `secondary` (dark).

```html
<section class="section section-dark" style="text-align:center">
  <div class="container">
    <h2 class="text-h2" style="max-width:800px;margin:0 auto 16px;color:var(--color-text-primary-invert)">Heading</h2>
    <p class="text-body-large" style="max-width:560px;margin:0 auto 32px;color:var(--color-text-secondary-invert)">Subtext</p>
    <div class="cta-group cta-center">
      <a class="btn btn-primary btn-lg">Primary CTA</a>
      <a class="btn btn-ghost-invert btn-lg">Secondary CTA</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Don'ts:** Never use `.btn-secondary` on dark sections. Always use `.btn-ghost-invert` for the secondary button on dark backgrounds.

#### Pattern 18 — 2-col Text + Mockup

**When to use:** Feature showcase section, side-by-side text + product screenshot.
**Surface:** `primary` (white).

```html
<section class="section section-white">
  <div class="container">
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 7fr;gap:48px;align-items:center">
      <div>
        <div class="badge">...</div>
        <h2 class="text-h2" style="margin-bottom:16px">Heading</h2>
        <p class="text-body-large" style="color:var(--color-text-secondary);margin-bottom:32px">Subtext</p>
        <div class="cta-group cta-left">
          <a class="btn btn-primary btn-md">CTA</a>
          <a class="btn btn-secondary btn-md">Secondary</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div style="border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-soft-600);overflow:hidden">
          <!-- mockup screenshot -->
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key rules:**
- Text is LEFT-aligned (not centered like hero)
- CTAs use `md` size (48px), not `lg`
- Mockup has `border-radius: 16px` on ALL corners
- Shadow is `--shadow-soft-600` (not `--shadow-soft-800`)
- No border on the mockup

#### Pattern 19 — Pricing Section

**When to use:** Pricing plans, tiered feature comparison.
**Surface:** `alt` (soft gray).

```html
<section class="section section-alt">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-header" style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:48px">...</div>
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px">
      <div style="background:var(--color-surface-primary);border-radius:16px;padding:32px">
        <!-- standard plan -->
      </div>
      <div style="background:var(--color-surface-primary);border-radius:16px;padding:32px;border:2px solid var(--btn-bg-enable)">
        <!-- featured plan — border highlights it -->
      </div>
      <div style="background:var(--color-surface-primary);border-radius:16px;padding:32px">
        <!-- enterprise plan -->
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Key rules:**
- Featured pricing card uses `border: 2px solid var(--btn-bg-enable)` — the only place a border highlights a card
- Grid gap: 24px (not 32px)
- All 3 cards same height — use flexbox internally for button pinning

---

### Strict Rules — Never Break

1. Never use primitive tokens directly in components — use semantic tokens only. Exception: highlighted heading text uses `var(--btn-bg-enable)`.
2. Never hardcode hex colors in CSS or HTML.
3. Never use a font other than Work Sans.
4. Never place dark text on a dark surface or white text on a light surface.
5. Never use a placeholder or text as a logo — always use the actual SVG file.
6. Never have a mockup with no shadow — minimum `--shadow-soft-400`.
7. Never use back-to-back dark sections.
8. Never use more than 2 dark sections per page (footer excluded).
9. Never use a grid layout outside the 7 approved layouts.
10. Never show a lone CTA button — always pair primary + secondary side by side.
11. Never hardcode a button background color — must be `var(--btn-bg-enable)`.
12. Never design without `data-brand` set on the root element.
13. Never use `const` inside JSX function bodies — use `var`.
14. Never import icons from a library at runtime — always inline SVG path data.
15. Never use `.btn-secondary` on dark backgrounds — use `.btn-ghost-invert`.
16. Never put a border on a mockup frame — shadow provides the elevation.
17. Never wrap a mockup in a dark or colored container — it floats on the section background.
18. Never alternate the same surface twice in a row (alt → alt, primary → primary).
19. Never stack CTA buttons vertically on desktop — always side by side.
20. Never use more than 4 steps in Pattern 08, more than 3 cards in Pattern 07, or more than 4 rows in Pattern 05.

---

### Delivery Checklist

Run this before delivering any landing page section or full page:

**Tokens:**
- [ ] Every color references a semantic token — no raw hex, no primitive tokens in components
- [ ] `data-brand` is set on the root element
- [ ] `data-theme` is set on the root element (`light` or `dark`)

**Typography:**
- [ ] Every text element uses a `.text-*` class — no hardcoded font sizes
- [ ] Section headings max-width: 800px, centered
- [ ] Body/subtext max-width: 560px when centered
- [ ] Font is Work Sans — no substitutes

**Buttons:**
- [ ] Every CTA has primary + secondary paired
- [ ] No solo buttons
- [ ] Button size matches the context (hero = `lg`, section = `md`, card = `sm`)
- [ ] Dark section secondary buttons use `.btn-ghost-invert`

**Layout:**
- [ ] Only the 7 approved grid layouts are used
- [ ] Container max-width: 1200px, centered
- [ ] Section padding: 96px top and bottom (64px mobile)
- [ ] Within-section spacing matches the reference table

**Mockups:**
- [ ] Every mockup has `border-radius: 16px` minimum
- [ ] Every mockup has shadow — minimum `--shadow-soft-400`
- [ ] No border on mockup frame
- [ ] No colored wrapper behind mockup

**Logos:**
- [ ] Light surface → `logo-dark.svg`
- [ ] Dark surface → `logo-inverted.svg`
- [ ] No placeholders — actual SVG files only

**Section alternation:**
- [ ] No two dark sections back to back
- [ ] No two identical surfaces back to back
- [ ] Max 1–2 dark sections per page (footer excluded)
- [ ] Footer is always dark

**Code:**
- [ ] No `const` inside JSX function bodies — `var` only
- [ ] All icons are inline SVG — no library imports
- [ ] Component CSS is duplicated inline in demo.html `<style>` block
